newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PT Tambang Timah says 1996 net up.
newsitem.headline: PT Tambang Timah says 1996 net up.

text.p: The world's biggest tin producer, Indonesian state-controlled firm PT Tambang Timah, said on Tuesday its 1996 net profit was 156.6 billion rupiah against 134.5 billion rupiah in 1995.
"The company sees profit growth of 16 percent in 1997," President-Director Erry Riyana Hardjapamekas said in a statement released at a news conference.
The statement said earnings per share were 311 rupiah in 1996 against 267 rupiah in 1995.
The statement said the company expected to produce 47,000 tonnes of tin in 1997 against an output of 41,000 tonnes in 1996.
